Container.Name: unraid-file-manager
Container.Overview: The server side of Unraid File Manager: a small HTTP agent that browses, edits, moves, copies and hashes files on your real disk paths (/mnt/disk1, /mnt/cache, /mnt/user, /boot). Deletes go to a Recycle Bin and can be undone; system and share roots are protected. It has no web page: it is used by the Unraid File Manager window on Windows (separate download), which needs the address of this container and the access token. WARNING: this container can read and change every file on the array and the flash drive. Keep the port on your LAN only, never forward it. Show the access token with: docker exec unraid-file-manager ufc-server serve --print-token
Container.Changes: 1.0.0: first container release of the agent (same agent that ran from the flash drive).

Config.Name: Agent port
Config.Description: Port the Windows window connects to. LAN only. If the old flash-drive agent still runs on 18767, pick another host port here (for example 18768) or stop the old one first.

Config.Name: Array and pools
Config.Description: All disks, pools, user shares and the Recycle Bin. Leave as /mnt.

Config.Name: Flash drive
Config.Description: The flash drive. Holds the access token, the PIN and file-edit backups (/boot/config/plugins/ufm) and lets you edit /boot/config files.
